terms.grammar: adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis)
terms.comment: The seventh month, counting from March (septem; Varro, LL 6.34). Ablative Septembrī; Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Septembrēs: the 1st, 5th and 13th.

phrases.latin: ego mē spērō Athēnīs fore mēnse Septembrī
phrases.english: I hope to be in Athens in September
